name: veltriz
description: Root workspace orchestrator — one `npm install` and one `npm run dev` for all 8 services/apps instead of 8 separate terminals.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n auth,economy,gameworld,admin-svc,simulation,crime,game-client,admin-client -c blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow,red,white,gray "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w economy-service" "npm run dev -w game-world-service" "npm run dev -w admin-service" "npm run dev -w simulation-service" "npm run dev -w crime-service" "npm run dev -w game-client" "npm run dev -w admin-client"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n auth,economy,gameworld,admin-svc,simulation,crime -c blue,green,cyan,magenta,yellow,red "npm run dev -w auth-service" "npm run dev -w economy-service" "npm run dev -w game-world-service" "npm run dev -w admin-service" "npm run dev -w simulation-service" "npm run dev -w crime-service"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently -k -n game-client,admin-client -c white,gray "npm run dev -w game-client" "npm run dev -w admin-client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w game-client && npm run build -w admin-client
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w economy-service && npm run seed:payments -w economy-service && npm run seed -w crime-service && npm run seed -w game-world-service && npm run seed -w simulation-service
